question: Should OpenClaw accept the legacy Installed Apps opt-in reset and the Play Data Safety/disclosure rollout plan for this Android release after the branch is rebased?
rationale: Source review shows the code fix is well targeted, but only a maintainer can accept the user-visible reset, source-external Play Console/privacy materials, and current-main conflict resolution.

options.title: Rebase and confirm rollout
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts, preserve main's newer Android work, and merge once the Play Data Safety, privacy policy, and disclosure wording are confirmed.

options.title: Adjust disclosure or release materials
options.body: Change the dialog wording, CSV, or rollout docs first if Play review or privacy expectations require a different presentation.

options.title: Pause until Play materials are ready
options.body: Keep the PR paused if the code, Play Console state, and privacy-policy update cannot ship together.

recommendation.title: Rebase and confirm rollout
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts, preserve main's newer Android work, and merge once the Play Data Safety, privacy policy, and disclosure wording are confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Android app work makes this the best available owner for the conflict-sensitive rebase and rollout choice.
